checks.finding: External frontier LLM weights are fixed; pretraining/fine-tuning/weight improvement excluded. Small downstream classifiers are the research task, not frontier-model development.
MetaN/HarnessDev are prior work; SkillFoundry explicitly prevents first-skill/science-application claims. Exact-combination novelty remains a candidate, not field-wide proof.

Same underlying history and task-local code rights for notes and learned-procedure arms; raw-source access remains available. Primary comparison is adaptive minus notes; strong fixed harness is reference.
Artifacts freeze before target tasks; no target experience passes between tasks; second model does not rebuild or tune harness from target feedback.

48 target runs =2models*3arms*4tasks*2lineages;8 source experience runs; extraction/verification explicitly additional. Four independent dataset units, not multiplied pseudoreplicates. Previous204-run candidate is not the selected design.

Equal resource ceilings distinguished from equal spending; actual token/cache/CPU/wall cost and overhead are recorded. No measured cost or power claim; caps calibrated on development only. Failures and unobserved accuracy distinguished without declaring a winner from successful submissions alone.
Same artifact transferred to fixed second model; adaptive-minus-notes within each model separates model score from harness gain. No claim about all future frontier models.
HarnessDev Evolution code-only and unstable fixed-executor transfer, and MetaN trace/code-to-strategy/helpers with estimator/heldout caveats, match full texts read in this lane.
Prototype is downstream plan; no native construction or efficacy execution claimed.

limitations: This verdict applies only to the recorded README snapshot and design consistency.
No experiment was run and no exact task/model/budget manifest was certified.
RecEvolve, SkillZip and SkillFoundry primary conclusions were not independently re-read in this review; their prose avoids the requested first-invention/weight-training overclaims.
root_recommendation: No serious inconsistency found; no required correction in this scope. Keep the selected56-run pilot arithmetic and separate extraction/verification costs; do not carry forward this lane's superseded204-run proposal.
actions: Only final-design-check.md/.json written. No source search, tests, native edits or new gates.
